column3: Close to the Hebrew; “their masters” is rendered “your husbands,” and NKJV supplies “wine.”
Close to the Hebrew; “with barbs … with fish hooks” is rendered “with fishhooks … with fishhooks.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you will throw [yourselves] toward Harmon” is rendered “you will be cast into Harmon.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to the morning … to three days” is rendered “every morning … every three days.”
Close to the Hebrew; “make smoke from what is leavened” is rendered “Offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they staggered” is rendered “wandered.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to make many” (or “the multitude of”) is rendered “When your gardens increased.”
Close to the Hebrew; “with the capture of your horses” is rendered “Along with your captive horses.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I overthrew among you” is rendered “I overthrew some of you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in consequence of this” is rendered “Because.”
